run_model_slip_predictions: run the TestSlipSL model on a dataset and dataloader to generate slip and force predictions saved as numpy arrays
get_overall_metrics_classification: get overall classification metrics including balanced accuracy, RMSE, and Pearson correlation for slip detection and force prediction
make_plots_trajectories: make visualization plots for slip predictions and delta forces across selected trajectories from the test dataset
plot_slip_trajectory: plot slip ground truth versus predictions over time with displacement scatter and friction cone visualization for a trajectory
plot_delta_forces_trajectory: plot predicted versus ground truth delta shear and normal forces over time for a given trajectory
